name: rundot_template
description: Production-minded RUN.world reference with PixiJS, Three.js, and hybrid WebGPU-first patterns.

scripts.lint: biome lint src additional_features e2e scripts playwright.config.ts vite.config.js --diagnostic-level=error --max-diagnostics=none
scripts.test: node scripts/check-template.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/test-return-reminders.ts && node scripts/check-player-number-formatting.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/check-safe-area.ts && node scripts/test-noise-random.mjs && node scripts/simulate-demo.mjs
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build && node scripts/check-build.mjs embedded
scripts.build:bundled: npm run typecheck && cross-env RUNDOT_GAME_DISABLE_EMBEDDED_LIBS=true vite build && node scripts/check-build.mjs bundled
scripts.build:multiplayer: npm run typecheck && cross-env RUNDOT_MULTIPLAYER=1 vite build && node scripts/check-build.mjs multiplayer
scripts.build:syncplay: npm run typecheck && cross-env RUNDOT_SYNCPLAY=1 vite build && node scripts/check-build.mjs syncplay
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run audit:public && npm run build && npm run build:bundled
scripts.check:all: npm run check && npm run test:e2e && npm run build:multiplayer && npm run build:syncplay
